purpose: Enforce blinding technically for E2a adequacy-only search: forbidden observables must not exist in E2a artifact, preventing leakage into theta* selection

enforcement.check: grep -R forbidden_observables in E2a artifact must be 0 hits; E2a analysis script must not import classifiers/G_spec/SI
enforcement.blinding_mechanism: E2a search script operates only on adequacy gates and raw rates, imports only e2_ping_prereg.json adequacy_gates and e2_ssa_spec.json SSA.adequacy, never classifiers

f_select_blinded: theta* = argmax_{theta in Theta_search} (G_adequate rate) with deterministic tie-break; no forbidden observable may influence selection
f_fail_blinded: if no adequate point, UNRESOLVED/INVALID, not NO_PING/NO_SSA
